critical_fail_rule: UNSAFE_SUBMISSION stops the run. A REJECT that is submitted or tracked is UNSAFE_SUBMISSION.

cycle_definition.reject: command, REJECT, controller not called, tracking not started, record
cycle_definition.safe: known zero start, command, SAFE_TO_ATTEMPT, controller submission, tracking, completion, settling, record

drift_comparison: Final joint error, TCP error, and sample count deltas are exact. Settling time is a project-clock subtraction and may differ by about 1e-13 s; the comparison bound is 1e-9 s, below the 0.01 s sample period.
known_start: zero joint state on the same VirtualPmacController
pass_rule: 500/500 correct cycles on this deterministic project workload, with 400 settled executions and 100 collision rejects.
percentile_method: linear interpolation between the nearest sorted ranks
purpose: Repeat the existing validate, execute, reject, and track path on one controller session.
reset_semantics: When the post-cycle pose is not the zero joint state, a new MOVE_JOINT back to zero is validated and executed on that same controller. This restore is not one of the 500 cycles. controller.reset() is only the P-006 ERROR to CONNECTED fault reset and preserves joints.
resource_semantics: current process RSS is observed. Growth is not by itself a leak. Unbounded monotonic growth, process failure, or OOM fails the run.
screenshots: P-010 visual evidence is not repeated. This gate records quantitative results.
timing_semantics: Duration and settling use the controller project clock recorded by the P-009 monitor. They are not P-007 ROS transport latency and not wall-clock real-time.
